Description: As an employee, I want to submit an equipment request through a self-service portal with structured fields (item, cost center, justification) so that my request is captured completely without email back-and-forth.
As the system, I want to validate each request against policy and budget rules automatically so that invalid or unbudgeted requests are flagged before reaching an approver.
As the system, I want to auto-route validated requests to the correct approver using a cost-center matrix so that requests reach the right person without manual forwarding.
As an approver, I want a defined SLA window to approve or reject requests so that requests don't stall indefinitely.
As the system, I want to auto-escalate unactioned requests to the next-level approver so that delays resolve without manual follow-up.
As IT/Procurement, I want an auto-generated, pre-populated fulfillment ticket after approval so that I don't manually re-enter request details.
As an employee, I want to see the real-time status of my request so that I don't need to email IT to check progress.
As IT/Procurement, I want the ticket to auto-close once equipment is marked delivered so that closed tickets don't need manual cleanup.
As an approver, I want to reject a request with a stated reason so that the requester understands why it did not proceed, instead of the request simply stalling.
As a Digital Workplace analyst, I want a dashboard of average cycle time and approval delay by cost center so that I can identify bottlenecks after launch.
